authorized_onboarding:
✨ Chromantis is ready for this chat.

The easiest way to use it:
- Send a plain request like a normal message.
- Use the buttons to browse years, people, or random memories.
- Open Search Help if you want examples before searching.

What this bot is good at:
- Finding archive photos by year, topic, folder wording, or curated people.
- Helping you browse without memorizing commands.
- Returning a few images first so it stays simple.

To get better results:
- Use a year when you know it.
- Use archive words that are likely to appear in folder names.
- Use a curated person name if one has been linked.
- If a search is too broad, ask for fewer images first.

Good examples:
- show me photos from 2021
- show me 2 city photos from 2021
- beach photos from 2019
- random summer memory
- show me photos of Pablo

Advanced commands still work:
- /years
- /images 2 city 2021
- /random 1 beach
- /people

🙂 Tip: if you are not sure where to begin, press one of the buttons below.
You can change language later in /settings.
clarify_text:

guest_onboarding:
👋 Welcome to Chromantis.

What this bot does:
It searches the indexed photo archive and sends matching images back in this chat.

What I need from you:
Use words that are likely to exist in folder names, tags, years, or curated people names. You do not need commands for normal use.

Important limits:
- I only search what has already been indexed.
- Results depend on archive names, years, and curated people links.
- If nothing appears, try a year, a simpler keyword, or browse with the buttons.

Examples you can send after login:
- show me photos from 2021
- beach photos from 2019
- show me 3 city photos
- random family memory

Advanced commands:
- /years
- /images 3 city 2021
- /random 2 beach

🔐 Access is required before I can search for this chat.
Login with: /login <access-code>

🙂 Tip: after login, you can just talk to the bot naturally or use the buttons below.
You can change language later in /settings.
help_authorized:
How to use Chromantis:
- Type a plain request like 'show me 2 city photos from 2021'.
- Use /years to browse the archive by year.
- Use /images [count] <query> for direct searches.
- Use /random [count] [query] for discovery.
- Use /settings to change language.

Admin commands are still available for curation and chat management.
